svg.title: Jaundice sorted by where bilirubin is held up: pre-hepatic hemolysis, hepatic problems of conjugation (Gilbert, Crigler-Najjar, newborn jaundice), excretion (Dubin-Johnson, Rotor) or intrahepatic cholestasis, and post-hepatic obstruction or biliary atresia; urine bilirubin and the reticulocyte count make the first splits, then ultrasound, MRCP, ERCP or PTC image and relieve an obstruction
